question: 单项选择：Tom is the _____ student in our class. A. tall  B. taller  C. tallest  D. the tallest
answer: 答案：C. tallest。解析：最高级前加the。tall的最高级是tallest。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：This is ______ (interesting) book I have ever read.
answer: 答案：the most interesting。解析：interesting是多音节形容词，最高级前加the most。

question: 单项选择：Mount Qomolangma is _____ mountain in the world. A. high  B. higher  C. the highest  D. highest
answer: 答案：C. the highest。解析：最高级前要加the。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She is ______ (happy) girl in her family.
answer: 答案：the happiest。解析：happy以辅音+y结尾，变y为i加-est。

question: 单项选择：Today is _____ day of the year. A. hot  B. hotter  C. hottest  D. the hottest
answer: 答案：D. the hottest。解析：最高级前加the。hot是重读闭音节结尾，双写t加-est。

question: 单项选择：He is _____ boy in his class. A. tall  B. taller  C. the tallest  D. tallest
answer: 答案：C. the tallest。解析：最高级前加the。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：This is one of ______ (nice) parks in the city.
answer: 答案：the nicest。解析：one of + 最高级 + 复数名词。nice以e结尾，加-st。

question: 翻译句子：他是我们班最聪明的学生。
answer: 答案：He is the smartest student in our class. 解析：smart以重读闭音节结尾，双写t加-est。the smartest是最高级形式。

question: 单项选择：Of all the subjects, math is _____ for me. A. difficult  B. more difficult  C. the most difficult  D. most difficult
answer: 答案：C. the most difficult。解析：多音节形容词最高级前加the most。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：The Yangtze River is ______ (long) river in China.
answer: 答案：the longest。解析：long的最高级是longest。
